title.value: CKEditor AI: Meet your app’s new AI co-writer

summary.value: Introduction and overview webinar with me and Andrzej Kala (Senior Technical Product Leader). The narrative was: "Stop forcing your users to switch tabs between ChatGPT and your application. Learn how to integrate a powerful, context-aware AI co-writer directly into your rich text editor."

content.value:
Developers should no longer require their users to switch tabs between ChatGPT and their application. Instead, they can integrate a powerful, context-aware AI co-writer directly into their rich text editor.

The agenda of the webinar includes the following:

  • Introduction: An overview of the topic and format of the webinar, followed by introductions from the speakers, including Andrzej Kała.
  • Interview about CKEditor AI: A detailed discussion through interview questions, covering the features and functionalities of CKEditor AI.
  • Showcase of implementing CKEditor AI: Demonstrating how to integrate CKEditor AI into a sample application, including asynchronous collaboration presets, AI chat features, AI actions, and AI review capabilities.
  • Walkthrough of the showcase: A practical walkthrough of the project, selecting text and using it as context.
  • Wrap-up questions: Addressing audience questions to conclude the webinar.
